place.name: Bellver Castle
place.description: Bellver Castle (Catalan: Castell de Bellver [kəsˈteʎ də ˌbeʎˈvə]) is a Gothic-style castle on a hill 3 km to the west of the center of Palma de Mallorca on the island of Mallorca, Balearic Islands, Spain. It was built in the 14th century for King James II of Majorca, and is one of the few circular castles in Europe.
